scenarios.name: double-colorless-unavailable-at-four-lands
scenarios.why: The Temple plus three other lands is four lands, one short of the stated five-land threshold.

scenarios.name: double-colorless-offered-at-five-lands
scenarios.why: The Temple and four other lands total exactly five, meeting the activation threshold.

scenarios.name: double-colorless-produced-at-five-lands
scenarios.why: At exactly five lands the ability is legal; activating and resolving it adds two colorless mana.
